feed_title: Deep Sided Nest Dog Bed, Fibre Filled Base, Zipped 30C Washable Cover, Medium and Large | PawLunova Wensleydale
descriptionHtml:
Deep enclosing sides. A fibre-filled base. Two sizes and no third decision.

Wensleydale is a deep sided nest dog bed with enclosing walls right round a soft fibre filled base, in Medium and Large. The zipped cover washes at 30°C.

There are dogs who curl and dogs who stretch. A curler on a flat mattress spends ten minutes walking the edges, hunting for a side that is not there.

This is the other choice, made on purpose. Deep sides right round and fibre filling underneath, so the bed yields and encloses rather than holding a dog level the way a firm foam mattress does.

What they get

  • Deep enclosing sides: Edges to tuck and lean against on every side of the base.
  • A fibre-filled base: Soft at the centre, for a dog who likes to sink rather than be held up.
  • A deliberate alternative to foam: This is a nest format and not a memory foam mattress.
  • Two options: Medium at £69 and Large at £89.
  • A zipped cover: It removes for a 30°C wash.

Best for: Dogs who burrow into soft bedding, and dogs who sleep curled tight against a high side.

Why it is worth the money

Medium is £69 and Large is £89, and there is no third size to agonise over. The money goes on depth of side and softness of base, which is what a burrowing dog keeps asking for. If you have already bought a foam bed they ignore, this is the opposite experiment, and the 100 nights cover it either way.

Now the awkward part. Outside measurements are not published for Wensleydale and we are not going to invent them for you. Send us the breed and the weight first and we will tell you which of the two to take.

Size and fit

Two sizes are listed: Medium and Large. Exact figures are not published for this bed, so ask us before ordering rather than guessing from a photograph. Deep sides take up part of whatever footprint you end up with. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Medium or Large?

With no published figures, send the breed and the weight and we will pick.

Will delivery be charged?

Not on anything over £40. Lead times live on the shipping page.

Can I pay in instalments?

It can be. Look for the options during checkout.

Why are there no measurements?

We have no verified set for this bed, and a wrong number costs you.

Will it do for an old dog who is slow to rise?

Soft fibre yields under weight rather than holding it level. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The zipped cover comes off for a 30°C cycle.

What if they simply do not take to it?

That is what the 100 nights answer, at no cost to you.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick Medium or Large and give a burrower somewhere to sink into.
